content.bridge_context: Exploring the physical world by identifying different types of materials and their properties.

units.title: Natural vs. Man-made
units.explanation: Materials can come directly from nature (wood, stone) or be made by humans (plastic, glass).
units.dual_language_instruction: Name one thing made of wood and one made of plastic. / लकड़ी और प्लास्टिक से बनी एक-एक चीज़ का नाम बताएं।

units.title: Appearance and Feel
units.explanation: Materials are grouped by how they look (shiny/dull) and how they feel (rough/smooth).
units.dual_language_instruction: Touch a stone and a silk cloth. How do they differ? / एक पत्थर और एक रेशमी कपड़े को छुएं। वे कैसे अलग हैं?
